buy_only_if.rainbow_chaser: sell it the same turn it pays 5 or more
buy_only_if.will_o_the_wisp: a ringed slot will stay empty at combat
buy_only_if.sally_spore: before T5; sell her when the slot is needed

place.shy_units: B2 or B3, the slots with the fewest Rings
place.nan_toadstool: played on B1 while B1 is empty; sold from B1

stander_on_carry_slot: changeling if the enemy unit in B1 is bigger than our stander would be
hedge_witch if the enemy unit in B1 has Attack at least half our B1 Ring
otherwise belladonna, else the biggest body we own

spells.spore_cloud: buy; aim at the rainbow's missing slot, else B1
spells.boundary_stone: buy; aim at the rainbow's missing slot, else B1
spells.pinch_of_dust: only to thank a Shy unit
spells.hiring_fair: at T5+ with 5+ Fairies and no fairy_monarch by R11
spells.horseshoe: buy when the scout shows a Fairy carry; aim across its slot

thank: lob_lie_by_the_fire: when its turns on board reach a multiple of 3 and silky is on board; else at 6
hob_in_the_hearth: only with silky on board, or when the slot is needed (about R13)
silky: last, after the other Shy units have left
save: R1-R8: spend to 0, holding only the next scheduled tier-up
from R9: hold 6 for hiring_fair while at T5+ with no fairy_monarch
otherwise churn the rest: buy the cheapest unit, play it in the flex slot, sell it (Annis Rings B1); stop at 1 gold
knobs: Annis F1 or F2 (one giant or two)

buy_only_if.rainbow_chaser: hold until 6+ slots have a Ring, then sell
buy_only_if.cradle_fetch: one slot holds over a third of the board

place.queen_of_elfland: F4; a cheap unit in B3 every turn
place.will_o_the_wisp: B2 once the Queen is down
place.changeling: B1, or across the scouted biggest enemy
place.nan_toadstool: played into an unringed slot, then sold
place.sally_spore: beside the gap that most needs a Ring; later beside the tithe slot

spells.spore_cloud: the rainbow's missing slot first, then B1 or B2
spells.boundary_stone: the rainbow's missing slot first, then B1 or B2
spells.pinch_of_dust: only to thank a Shy unit
spells.hiring_fair: at T6 with 5+ Fairies and no Fairy tier 6
spells.horseshoe: buy when the scout shows a Fairy carry

thank: lob_lie_by_the_fire: at 3 turns if silky is on board, else at 6
save: never bank more than 2, except to hold the Chaser for a turn where its sale pays a tier-up and a buy
with the Queen down: keep 3 gold each turn for the unit she tithes
churn the rest through Annis (2 Rings a sale from F2); stop at 1 gold
knobs: Queen in F2/F3 (two tithes a turn) or F4
Monarch or a second answer on B1
